title: Divergence: thermite-spec validator silently accepts arbitrary (non-built-in) MethodCall in contract; cage leak vs REQ-3(c)/REQ-4(iv)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-spec/tests/divergence_spec.rs::divergence_unknown_method_call_in_contract_is_rejected (run with --include-ignored). 'req xs.frobnicate()' validates clean (Ok(())). Root cause: validator.rs walk_expr_inner Expr::MethodCall arm accepts ANY method name structurally, only recursing into receiver+args; it never checks the method name against the bounded built-in set. The oracle accept fixtures only exercise xs.len(), so this cage leak is invisible to existing fixtures (over-fitting). Authority: .design/spec/spectherm-combinators.md REQ-3(c) ('the bounded built-in MethodCalls the grammar admits, e.g. xs.len()') + REQ-4(iv) (forbidden parsed construct -> ForbiddenCall); thermite-design.md §4.2 (locks the cage).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Critic pins this divergence as a failing test only (no fix — discriminator role). Committing thermite-spec/tests/divergence_spec.rs with the #[ignore]d failing tests for #35 and #36 as the audit artifact.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Fixed in eae38c3 (thermite-spec/src/validator.rs). Root cause: the Expr::MethodCall arm accepted ANY method name structurally — 'req xs.frobnicate()' validated clean. Fix: bounded the allowlist with const BUILTIN_METHODS = [len] (REQ-3(c) — len is the only method the corpus uses in contracts: haystack.len(), xs.len()). A non-allowlisted method in a caged position now pushes SpecError::ForbiddenCall (REQ-4 iv); operands still recursed (REQ-5). Authority: .design/spec/spectherm-combinators.md REQ-3(c)/REQ-4(iv); thermite-design.md §4.2. Verify: divergence_unknown_method_call_in_contract_is_rejected now PASSES (un-ignored, asserts ForbiddenCall); bogus method in inv and in spec-fn body also rejected; cargo test -p thermite-spec 8 passed 0 failed 0 ignored; clippy/fmt/workspace-build PASS.
